title: Stats
summary: Coin points from every run add up to SP; spend SP to raise Ade’s HP, Defense and Recovery.

sections.title: Stat levels
sections.note: Defense is the damage Ade takes from one obstacle hit (lower is better). Recovery is the HP one chocolate restores. Each level up costs 1 SP.

sections.title: Earning SP
sections.text: You earn 1 SP for every 1,500 coin points collected in total, up to 27 SP (40,500 coin points) — enough to raise all three stats from level 1 to 10.
